objective: Fix the remaining windows CI failure of PR 78 (branch release/0.3.0/feat/pi-extension, head 2cfba72, worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-ext): the test 'a bad .holyagent/config.json is reported with the field it names' fails with EBUSY removing its temp project.
scope: Log: /home/user/holyagent-notes/win78b.log (failure around lines 2205-2225; it is the only failing test). The cleanup rm of the temp project fails with EBUSY on Windows, which means a process still has the project folder open when the test finishes.

Likely cause to confirm from the code: in packages/integrations/pi/src/extension.ts, config and `state mode` run together; when config fails, collect returns the notice while the sibling `state mode` process, which chdirs into the project through --project in packages/runtime/src/hooks/pi-entry.ts, may still be running. If so this is a code defect, not only a test issue: the extension leaves a child process running after it delivers. Make the extension stop and wait for every child it started before a gather completes, on success, failure and deadline (abort the sibling's signal and await its exit), and add a test that asserts no exec is still pending when the delivered result is returned, including the config-failure case. If the cause is different, state it from the evidence and fix that.
Do not 'fix' it by retrying or ignoring the rm error in the test.
constraints: Never skip, disable, weaken or retry-loop a test to get green.
Make no version-control writes; report changed paths.
Run bunx --no-install mise run verify and bunx --no-install mise run build in the worktree.
Report in under 300 words; start each evidence line with the exact criterion text, a colon, then the support.

criteria.text: The EBUSY cause is stated from the evidence and fixed in the code, so no child process outlives a gather
A test asserts no exec is pending when a gather delivers, including when config fails
